snippet.title: Chained Wheels - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Chained Wheels.

A challenging physics-based online co-op car game where two vehicles are literally chained together.
Communication is everything. One wrong move can end the run for both of you.

Wishlist on Steam – Coming Soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4243690/Chained_Wheels
